description: Updates an existing career journal entry. Only the fields provided will be changed — all other fields remain as-is. Use this to refine descriptions, add missing numbers to the metrics field, correct the entry date, or re-type an entry. This is the right tool to backfill quantification on entries saved without a full three-number breakdown (scale of action, direct result, organizational impact). When updating an achievement description, keep a complete STAR story (situation, task, action, result) in the user's own voice; labeled Situation:/Task:/Action:/Result: headings are optional and not required.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

description.description: Updated narrative text. For achievements, a well-structured unlabeled STAR narrative in the user's own voice is fine; do not require Situation:/Task:/Action:/Result: labels.

experience_id.description: Re-links the entry to a different role, or pass null to unlink it from any role. experience_id is the integer ID of one of the user's own work experience records (a role on their GigHQ profile). Get valid IDs from `list_experiences` (or the gighq://experience resource), which returns each role's experience_id, title, and company; entries already linked to a role show it as experience_id in `list_career_entries` and `get_career_entry`. Never guess or reuse an ID from another user. GigHQ rejects IDs that aren't the user's own. Omit it to leave the current link unchanged.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

metrics.description: Updated quantifiable impact using the three-number rule: (1) scale of action, (2) direct result, (3) organizational impact. Use this to backfill missing numbers on entries that were saved without them.

tags.description: Updated comma-separated skill or topic tags. There is no application-level limit on tag count or on the length of this field (it is stored as unbounded PostgreSQL text). Prefer skill or topic tokens; job-fit ranking treats tags as searchable text alongside the title and description.

type.description: Updated type: 1=achievement, 2=project, 3=skill_acquired, 4=reflection. Pass an integer or the label string.

uuid.description: UUID of the career entry to update. Returned by add_career_entry or list_career_entries.

name: update_career_entry
